blocks.x: Last mile is the costliest mile: route density, delivery promise, failed-delivery economics and urban access rules. Dynamic routing, fleet telemetry and micro-hub orchestration decide whether the final mile makes money.

The workflows we industrialize here: Dynamic routing, Delivery promise management, Failed-delivery recovery, Micro-hub operations, Fleet electrification. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.
